'''Fleet Group ''Right to Rule''''' was one of several [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] battle groups present for the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]] fought during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was commanded by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Right to Rule]]''. During the Battle of [[Borosk]], the fleet group was assigned to protect the Remnant's rear.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
